definitions.explanation: A color that is a blend of blue and purple, leaning more toward the blue end. A compound of {青|あお} (blue) and {紫|むらさき} (purple).

examples.japanese: ⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{青紫|あおむらさき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}まった→染まる：04254_somaru⟧。
{青紫|あおむらさき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{紫陽花|あじさい}→紫陽花：04997_ajisai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}いている→咲く：08150_saku⟧。

⟦{夕暮|ゆうぐ}れ→夕暮れ：07682_yuugure⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{青紫|あおむらさき}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{濃紺|のうこん}→濃紺：15616_noukon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}わって→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧いく⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しかった→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: It was beautiful watching the evening sky change from blue-purple to dark navy.

notes:
A compound color name combining ⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧ (blue) and ⟦{紫|むらさき}→紫：00297_murasaki⟧ (purple). This is a common pattern in Japanese for naming intermediate colors. The color sits between blue and purple on the spectrum.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {青紫|あおむらさき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧: blue-purple flowers
- {青紫|あおむらさき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}まる→染まる：04254_somaru⟧: to be dyed blue-purple
- {青紫|あおむらさき}⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧: blue-purple color

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{紫|むらさき}→紫：00297_murasaki⟧: purple — one of the component colors
- ⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧: blue — the other component color
- {赤紫|あかむらさき}: red-purple; magenta — the opposite blend, leaning toward red
- ⟦{藍|あい}→藍：20100_ai⟧: indigo — a deep blue-violet dye and color with historical significance in Japan
